chunks: Then We lodged you in a secure place (the womb)

key_terms.فَجَعَلْنَاهُ: Then We made it / placed it
key_terms.قَرَارٍ: a secure, stable place or dwelling

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the secure placement of the fetus in the womb?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'qarar' (secure place) is often interpreted not only as physical stability but also as a spiritual and metaphysical anchoring of the soul's potential within the maternal womb. This verse underscores the divine precision in embryological development, reflecting the concept of 'Tawhid al-Af'al' (Oneness of Divine Action) where every stage of creation is meticulously orchestrated by God's will.
